review_candidates.title: Commercial Marketing Manager
review_candidates.description: Reports to: General Manager / Marketing Director / Group Project Director, MMI Asia Pte Ltd Based in: We don’t really care where you connect to wifi. We care about your results. Singapore/Thailand/Vietnam/Philippines/Malaysia, with regular travel across Southeast Asia Works with: Sales, operations and the show teams – plus regional agencies and media partners In most exhibition companies, marketing fills the hall for everyone else and waits to be thanked. Here, marketing owns a budget, a target, and the ticketing line on the P&L. Your campaigns are measured in revenue – not impressions. The role MMI Asia builds the trade shows where entire industries across Southeast Asia meet, do business and decide what comes next. Behind every packed hall is a marketing engine that put the right people in the room – and, increasingly, sold them the pass to be there. This is not a brand-and-banners job. We’re looking for a commercial marketer who treats a marketing budget like an investment portfolio: spend where it returns, cut what doesn’t, and own the number at the end of the quarter. You’ll be directly accountable for the revenue we generate from ticketing – paid visitor passes, premium and VIP access, co-located summit and conference seats – alongside the qualified attendance that makes our floor space worth what exhibitors pay for it. Own the number This is the part that makes the role different. You’ll be given a marketing budget and a ticketing revenue target, and the autonomy to decide how to hit both. And it’s not just ticketing – you also get credit for lead generation and the resulting deals that your sales colleagues close. Own the ticketing P&L. Forecast, price-test and drive revenue from paid visitor passes, early-bird tiers, VIP and delegate packages, and co-located conference seats. Run the acquisition budget end to end. Paid media, email, content, partnerships and on-ground – reported the way a P&L owner reports: in cost-per-acquisition and revenue, not clicks. Feed the floor. Build and convert the visitor and buyer pipeline that gives exhibitors a reason to keep buying space, edition after edition. Own lead gen. Build and deliver the qualified-lead pipeline that sales turns into stand bookings and sponsorship. Build the affiliate engine. Recruit and manage a network of affiliates and referral partners — media owners, associations, content creators and industry ambassadors — who sell passes and surface leads on a pay-for-performance basis, so a chunk of the funnel costs nothing until it actually converts. Get credit for the full picture. Ticketing revenue is your headline number, but exhibitor promotion and the leads you generate count towards it too – when the floor sells and the pipeline fills, that’s your win as much as the sales team’s. Treat every campaign as a test. Know your CAC, your conversion rate and your payback by channel – and reallocate spend without waiting to be asked. Defend the number in the room. Bring the data to commercial reviews and say plainly what’s working, what’s being switched off, and where the next dollar should go. What you’ll actually do Demand generation & campaigns Plan and run multi-channel acquisition campaigns – paid search and social, email, content, programmatic, association and influencer partnerships – across the full show cycle. Build audience segments and journeys that move a cold contact to a registered, paid or hosted attendee – and bring them back next edition. Own registration end to end: landing pages, the sign-up flow, pricing tiers and abandoned-cart recovery. Brand, content & channel Keep the show brands sharp, consistent and unmistakably MMI – across web, social, print and on-site. Shape content that sells: speaker line-ups, agenda reveals, exhibitor stories, market data and the “why you can’t miss this” narrative. Own the channel mix and the marketing calendar, and brief agencies and freelancers to deliver on time and on budget. What you bring Sharp copy instincts and a good eye, even if you’re not the one in the design file – you know what makes someone click “register” and pay. Fluency across the modern stack – paid media platforms, marketing automation, CRM, registration systems affiliate marketing. Several years in B2B marketing – ideally events, exhibitions, media or another business where marketing carries a revenue or registration target. Think the discipline of a conference marketer, or the visitor-acquisition a festival organizer. The bias of an operator: you’d rather ship, measure and adjust than wait for the perfect plan. You’re probably not the right fit if… “Marketing” to you means making things look nice and hoping for the best. You measure success in impressions and likes rather than registrations and revenue. A budget and a target feel like pressure rather than the best part of the job. You need a fully briefed plan before you’ll move – and someone else to own the result. “What was the ROI on that?” makes you defensive rather than ready. Why MMI Asia MMI Asia is the Singapore-based subsidiary of Messe München – one of the world’s largest and most respected exhibition organisers. Yes, we are home to the F.C. Bayern Munich, Oktoberfest (we call it Wiesn), pretzels, and Adele’s spectacular summer concerts. We’re now in an ambitious growth phase in the region, through new launches, geo-clones, partnerships, joint ventures, and acquisitions. We hire ambitious, people-first professionals and give them the brands, the backing, and the room to do the best work of their careers.

review_candidates.description: ACER COE – Postdoctoral Researcher in Membrane and Electrode Technologies for Battery and Fuel-Cell System About UM6P Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P) is an internationally oriented institution of higher learning, that is committed to an educational system based on the highest standards of teaching and research in fields related to the sustainable economic development of Morocco and Africa. UM6P is an institution oriented towards applied research and innovation. On a specific focus on Africa, UM6P aims to position these fields as the forefront and become a university of international standing. More than just a traditional academic institution, UM6P is a platform for experimentation and a pool of opportunities, for students, professors and staff. It offers a high-quality living and study environment thanks to its state-of-the-art infrastructure. With an innovative approach, UM6P places research and innovation at the heart of its educational project as a driving force of a business model. In its research approach, the UM6P promotes transdisciplinary, entrepreneurship spirit and collaboration with external institutions for developing up to date science and at continent level in order to address real challenges. All our programs run as start-ups and can be self-organized when they reach a critical mass. Thus, academic liberty is promoted as far as funding is developed by research teams. The research programs are integrated from long-term research to short-term applications in linkage with incubation and start-up ecosystems. About ACER CoE The Centre was established to address enduring process challenges in Chemistry and Engineering disciplines and create an environment for interdisciplinary research. The research program of ACER CoE is multidisciplinary, with faculty members from backgrounds in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and Environmental Engineering focusing on different research fields such as catalysis, separation, energy generation, conversion and storage, and organic optoelectronics intelligent and advanced polymers and materials. Job Description A postdoctoral position is currently available in the field of Membrane and Electrode Technologies for Battery and Fuel-Cell Systems. The aim of this position is to advance scientific research and development of high-performance specific membranes for different applications (Catalytic materials and electrodes for fuel cell applications; Polymer electrolyte for Lithium-ion Batteries). The main objective of this position is to develop and synthesize suitable membranes, optimize their integration and shaping into functional electrodes or electrolyte, and finally evaluate their performance through fuel cell and battery testing. The Candidate Will Be Involved In Conducting original scientific research in the field of Membranes, Polymers for Batteries and fuel cells. Characterizing the developed membranes using appropriate physicochemical, structural, morphological, and electrochemical techniques. Investigating the integration of polymer electrolyte membranes with catalytic electrodes to develop and optimize membrane–electrode assemblies. Designing Polymer Electrolye for safe batteries, Performing electrochemical and fuel cell performance tests under controlled operating conditions. Analyzing experimental results and preparing characterization and performance reports. Drafting scientific publications and patents. Position Requirements Ph.D. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrochemistry, Energy Engineering, Physics, or a closely related field. Strong background in battery systems, fuel-cell technologies, hydrogen technologies, or electrochemical energy conversion. Demonstrated experience in membrane synthesis, processing, and characterization. Knowledge of electrode fabrication, catalyst deposition, and electrode-forming techniques. Proficiency in physicochemical and electrochemical characterization methods. Experience in fuel-cell and battery testing, electrochemical measurements, and hydrogen-consumption analysis would be a significant advantage. Ability to analyze and interpret experimental data and establish correlations among material properties, electrode characteristics, and electrochemical performance. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.Applications must be submitted online; Criteria Of The Candidate PhD in the subject discipline. Prove ability to perform multidisciplinary research and contribute to funded research programs. Good English communication skills, both verbal and written are important. Application and Selection The Application Folder Must Contain (in One File) Detailed CV. Cover letter along with a synthetic presentation of the background, research works, projects and activities, publications, key achievements. Contact information of 3 referees.
